entries.name: Grokification
entries.does: Holds the oversight light on the lane board.
entries.helps: Shows the board is being watched.
entries.goal: The oversight light matches the board on 80% of opens.
entries.rules: The light stays on the header tile. This chip does not add a bot.

entries.name: Ara 2.1
entries.does: Second brain for the four apps.
entries.helps: Opens the Ara lane from the board.
entries.goal: 80% of board opens reach Ara without a wrong tile.
entries.rules: This tile stays cyan-blue. It is the only tile with the Ara deep link.

entries.name: Marvin Musk
entries.helps: Marks the Marvin Musk seat on the board.
entries.goal: The tile name stays Marvin Musk on 80% of reviews.
entries.rules: Use the alien mark. Do not rename the tile.

entries.name: Terafab
entries.does: Money: trades, F&H store, Qantas, pay-it-forward.
entries.helps: Keeps the money lane on one gold tile.
entries.goal: 80% of money prompts land on this lane.
entries.rules: No gear. No amounts on this card. The role line stays as written.

entries.name: Falcon 9
entries.helps: Holds the daytime loop on the board.
entries.goal: The daytime loop is named on 80% of board checks.
entries.rules: Status stays draft until the owner says otherwise.

entries.name: Neuralink
entries.helps: Puts the lock one tap from the board.
entries.goal: 80% of Neuralink taps open the gate and nothing else.
entries.rules: The gate asks for a PIN. The vault file is not in the repo.

entries.name: After Dark
entries.does: PIN gate for the locked panel.
entries.helps: Keeps vault text off the public board.
entries.goal: 80% of opens ask for a PIN before any vault read.
entries.rules: No PIN and no vault text in the repo. A missing file says the vault is sealed.

entries.name: Backend
entries.does: Lists each lane, its role, and draft status.
entries.helps: Gives one plain sheet for the board.
entries.goal: 80% of lane rows match the board tiles.
entries.rules: Infra is a task under Marvin/Bastion, not a tile. The side-button note stays on this sheet only.

entries.helps: Keeps this panel off the board.
entries.goal: 80% of visits arrive from the Nirvana header long-press.
entries.rules: No board link. No Julie link. A missing file says sealed.

entries.name: Julie
entries.goal: 80% of taps only echo the prompt.
entries.rules: This panel only echoes the five prompts. It does not open another lane.

entries.name: Automations
entries.helps: Lets a dry run show the self-check.
entries.goal: 80% of Test presses stay a dry run.
entries.rules: No secrets in the seed. Test does not send mail or start a job.

entries.name: SOP
entries.does: Prints the does, helps, 80% goal, and rules for one tile or panel.
entries.goal: 80% of tiles open a card that prints.
entries.rules: One card at a time. No secrets on the card.

automations.name: Falcon 9 daytime loop
automations.security: Dry run only. No keys, tokens, or mailboxes in this file.

automations.name: Pomodoro 5-minute tune
automations.security: Dry run only. Test does not start a timer off this page.

automations.name: Second brain digest / attention / nightly
automations.security: Dry run only. No digest text is stored here.

automations.name: Notes drain
automations.security: Dry run only. Notes are not pulled by this card.

automations.name: Nova reply watch
automations.security: Dry run only. No reply text and no account in this file.

automations.name: Meet recordings feed
automations.security: Dry run only. No recording links in this file.
